title: blechnum unisorum
intro: Blechnum unisorum, commonly known as New Zealand fern, is a type of vascular plant belonging to the Blechnaceae family. This plant is valued for its health benefits, including its potential to lower cholesterol levels, reduce blood pressure, and act as an antioxidant. Its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antiviral properties, making it useful for treating various health conditions. Blechnum unisorum contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
